records.subject: CST_M
records.title: Introduction to the Built Environment
records.description: Introduction to the construction industry; reviewing contract documents, methods of project management and current issues pertaining to the industry.

records.subject: CST_M
records.title: Materials I
records.prerequisiteText: Course Prerequisite: Admitted to the major in Construction Management or Architectural Studies.
records.description: Introduction to construction materials; primary materials used in below-grade substructures and above-grade superstructures using Construction Specification Institute (CSI) format.
records.prerequisiteReviewReason: Placement, eligibility, equivalency, credit or other non-course condition needs review.

records.subject: CST_M
records.title: Materials II
records.prerequisiteText: Course Prerequisite: CST M 201 with a C or better; admitted to the major in Construction Management or Architectural Studies.
records.description: Introduction to primary materials in construction of building envelopes, interiors, interior surfaces and finishes using Construction Specification Institute (CSI) format.
records.prerequisiteReviewReason: Placement, eligibility, equivalency, credit or other non-course condition needs review.

records.subject: CST_M
records.title: Culture of Construction Management
records.prerequisiteText: Course Prerequisite: Admitted to the major in Construction Management.
records.description: Introduction to the CM culture with focus on preparation for internships, student competitions, engagement opportunities, and success as a student within the program.
records.prerequisiteReviewReason: Placement, eligibility, equivalency, credit or other non-course condition needs review.

records.subject: CST_M
records.title: Construction Administration and Documentation
records.prerequisiteText: Course Prerequisite: CST M 102 with a C or better; CST M 201 with a C or better; admitted to the major in Construction Management.
records.description: Study and understanding of administrative procedures found within construction projects and respective documentation.
records.prerequisiteReviewReason: Placement, eligibility, equivalency, credit or other non-course condition needs review.

records.subject: CST_M
records.title: Construction Graphics
records.prerequisiteText: Course Prerequisite: CST M 102 with a C or better or ENGR 120 with a C or better; admitted to the major in Construction Management or Civil Engineering.
records.description: Visual literacy and details in construction documents using drawing techniques.
records.prerequisiteReviewReason: Placement, eligibility, equivalency, credit or other non-course condition needs review.

records.subject: CST_M
records.title: Building Science I
records.prerequisiteText: Course Prerequisite: 4 credits of PHYSICS 101 with a C or better, or PHYSICS 101 and 111 with a C or better; admitted major in Architectural Studies or Construction Management.
records.description: Mechanical systems for buildings; building heating, ventilating, and air conditioning systems, heat flow concepts.
records.prerequisiteReviewReason: Placement, eligibility, equivalency, credit or other non-course condition needs review.

records.subject: CST_M
records.title: Building Science II
records.prerequisiteText: Course Prerequisite: CST M 332 with a C or better; admitted to the major in Architectural Studies or Construction Management.
records.description: Water supply, drainage, electrical and lighting systems for buildings.
records.prerequisiteReviewReason: Placement, eligibility, equivalency, credit or other non-course condition needs review.

records.subject: CST_M
records.title: Earthwork and Equipment
records.prerequisiteText: Course Prerequisite: Admitted to the major in Construction Management or Civil Engineering.
records.description: Methods and procedures for site work, excavation, dewatering, building foundation and equipment, productivity, finance and safety requirements.
records.prerequisiteReviewReason: Placement, eligibility, equivalency, credit or other non-course condition needs review.

records.subject: CST_M
records.title: Legal Aspects of Construction and Design
records.prerequisiteText: Course Prerequisite: CST M 252 with a C or better; B LAW 210 with a C or better; admitted to the major in Construction Management.
records.description: Statutory and common law governing the practice of design and construction in the US; emphasis in architecture and construction project contract administration.
records.prerequisiteReviewReason: Placement, eligibility, equivalency, credit or other non-course condition needs review.

records.subject: CST_M
records.title: Safety and Health
records.prerequisiteText: Course Prerequisite: CST M 356 with a C or better or concurrent enrollment; admitted to the major in Construction Management; junior standing.
records.description: Role and function of safety and health in the construction industry including OSHA compliance, requirements and regulations.
records.prerequisiteReviewReason: Placement, eligibility, equivalency, credit or other non-course condition needs review.

records.subject: CST_M
records.title: Estimating I
records.prerequisiteText: Course Prerequisite: CST M 252 with a C or better; admitted to the major in Construction Management.
records.description: Admitted civil engineering majors may take by permission. Applications of quantity survey, techniques in creation of unit costs, introduction of job expenses and bid presentation.
records.prerequisiteReviewReason: Placement, eligibility, equivalency, credit or other non-course condition needs review.

records.subject: CST_M
records.title: Estimating II
records.prerequisiteText: Course Prerequisite: CST M 370 with a C or better; admitted to the major in Construction Management.
records.description: Bidding application, advance concepts in the creation of unit cost and computer software applications.
records.prerequisiteReviewReason: Placement, eligibility, equivalency, credit or other non-course condition needs review.

records.subject: CST_M
records.title: Delivery Systems
records.prerequisiteText: Course Prerequisite: CST M 252; admitted to the major in Construction Management, or junior standing in Architectural Studies, Interior Design, Landscape Architecture, or Civil Engineering.
records.description: Design/construction process and project delivery systems/approaches; analysis of construction management; the construction management process.
records.prerequisiteReviewReason: Placement, eligibility, equivalency, credit or other non-course condition needs review.

records.subject: CST_M
records.title: Methods and Procedures of Heavy Construction
records.prerequisiteText: Course Prerequisite: Admitted to the major in Construction Management; junior standing.
records.description: Methods and procedures for site work, heavy equipment, cranes, productivity; finance and safety requirements.
records.prerequisiteReviewReason: Placement, eligibility, equivalency, credit or other non-course condition needs review.

records.subject: CST_M
records.title: Construction Cost Accounting
records.prerequisiteText: Course Prerequisite: CON E 361 with a C or better or CST M 371 with a C or better; admitted to the major in Construction Management.
records.description: Examination of cost accounting utilized for specific project control as well as overall company control.
records.prerequisiteReviewReason: Placement, eligibility, equivalency, credit or other non-course condition needs review.

records.subject: CST_M
records.title: Planning and Scheduling
records.prerequisiteText: Course Prerequisite: CE 317 with a C or better, CON E 361 with a C or better, or CST M 371 with a C or better; admitted to the major in Construction Management or Civil Engineering.
records.description: Methods, principles, and concepts required to plan and schedule construction projects; introduction to scheduling software.
records.prerequisiteReviewReason: Placement, eligibility, equivalency, credit or other non-course condition needs review.

records.subject: CST_M
records.title: Heavy/Civil Estimating
records.prerequisiteText: Course Prerequisite: Admitted to the major in Construction Management, or junior standing and admitted to the major in Civil Engineering.
records.description: Estimating in quantity survey, price extension and bidding in civil projects.
records.prerequisiteReviewReason: Placement, eligibility, equivalency, credit or other non-course condition needs review.

records.subject: CST_M
records.title: Human Productivity in Construction
records.prerequisiteText: Course Prerequisite: CST M 460 with a C or better; admitted to the major in Construction Management.
records.description: Leadership and management concepts and methods applied to human behavior to enhance motivation, productivity and safety in construction.
records.prerequisiteReviewReason: Placement, eligibility, equivalency, credit or other non-course condition needs review.

records.subject: CST_M
records.title: Senior Capstone
records.prerequisiteText: Course Prerequisite: CST M 451 with a C or better; CST M 462 with a C or better; admitted to the major in Construction Management; junior standing.
records.description: Simulation of real world competition for Design-Build and/or CM at Risk (CM/GC) projects.
records.prerequisiteReviewReason: Placement, eligibility, equivalency, credit or other non-course condition needs review.

records.subject: CST_M
records.title: Building Information Modeling I
records.prerequisiteText: Course Prerequisite: Admitted to the major in Architectural Studies, Construction Management, Interior Design, or Landscape Architecture.
records.description: Use of Building Information Modeling (BIM) for construction coordination via emerging technologies and/or BIM software to collaborate with multiple distributed stakeholders and students from other disciplines.
records.prerequisiteReviewReason: Placement, eligibility, equivalency, credit or other non-course condition needs review.

records.subject: CST_M
records.title: Temporary Structures
records.prerequisiteText: Course Prerequisite: ARCH 352 with a C or better or CE 330 with a C or better; admitted to the major in Civil Engineering, Construction Management, or Architectural Studies.
records.description: Temporary structures including formwork, falsework, soldier pile and lagging, sheet pile, cofferdam, scaffolding, underpinning, bracing and guying, air domes, and others.
records.prerequisiteReviewReason: Placement, eligibility, equivalency, credit or other non-course condition needs review.

records.subject: CST_M
records.title: Mechanical, Electrical, and Plumbing I
records.prerequisiteText: Course Prerequisite: CST M 252 with a C or better, or admitted to the major in Architectural Studies, Mechanical Engineering, or Electrical Engineering.
records.description: Mechanical, Electrical, and Plumbing (MEP) portion of the construction industry, focusing on preconstruction services, design, sales and estimating, system, project management, sustainability, and the use of BIM as they relate to MEP. Two field trips required.
records.prerequisiteReviewReason: Placement, eligibility, equivalency, credit or other non-course condition needs review.

records.subject: CST_M
records.title: Seminar in Construction Management
records.prerequisiteText: Course Prerequisite: Admitted to the major in Construction Management.
records.description: Advanced study in construction practice management. May be repeated for credit; cumulative maximum 4 hours.
records.prerequisiteReviewReason: Placement, eligibility, equivalency, credit or other non-course condition needs review.

records.subject: CST_M
records.title: Special Problems
records.description: Independent study conducted under the jurisdiction of an approving faculty member; may include independent research studies in technical or specialized problems; selection and analysis of specified readings; development of a creative project; or field experiences.
